metadata.title: Why Mixing Two Frozen Quantum States Makes Probability Slosh
metadata.thing: a probability cloud in a well sloshing left-right, driven by two clocks turning at different rates
metadata.color_notes: Probability cloud = accent Warm Slate #5A5653 (filled). The two driving clock hands = ink (slow state 1) and accent (fast state 2). Well + labels = ink #1a1a1a. The closing 'two frozen states, motion' emphasis = red #C0392B.

beats.narration_text: Here's a particle trapped in a box.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Here's a particle trapped in a box.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a square-well box — two tall walls and a floor

beats.narration_text: Its lowest energy state has one smooth hump of probability that never moves.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Its lowest energy state has one smooth hump of probability that never moves.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: fill in the ground-state probability cloud — a single centred hump — and hold it still

beats.narration_text: The next state up has a two-lobed cloud — also frozen in place.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The next state up has a two-lobed cloud — also frozen in place.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: morph the cloud into the two-lobed first-excited-state probability cloud; hold it still

beats.narration_text: Each one is secretly spinning underneath, but at its own steady rate set by its energy.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each one is secretly spinning underneath, but at its own steady rate set by its energy.
beats.new_visual_element: two small clock hands appear, one slow (state 1) one fast (state 2)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: bring in a small Argand inset with two hands — a slow ink hand (state 1) and a fast accent hand (state 2) — both turning while the cloud stays still

beats.narration_text: Now add the two states together into one combined cloud.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now add the two states together into one combined cloud.
beats.new_visual_element: the combined superposition cloud forms (still snapshot)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: replace the single cloud with the combined two-state probability cloud, held still for a moment

beats.narration_text: As the two clocks drift apart, the combined cloud sloshes from one side of the box to the other.
beats.tts_normalized_text: As the two clocks drift apart, the combined cloud sloshes from one side of the box to the other.
beats.new_visual_element: the cloud pumps left then right as the clocks separate
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: start both clocks turning at different rates; the combined cloud sloshes left-right driven by their growing angle gap

beats.narration_text: The sloshing keeps time with the gap between the clocks — the difference in their energies.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The sloshing keeps time with the gap between the clocks — the difference in their energies.
beats.new_visual_element: the angle gap between the two hands highlighted as the driver
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: highlight the angle gap between the two hands while the cloud keeps sloshing in step with it

beats.narration_text: Two states that each go nowhere, mixed together, make probability move.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Two states that each go nowhere, mixed together, make probability move.
beats.new_visual_element: red label 'two frozen states, and the mix moves'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle on a slosh extreme and write a red label 'two frozen states, and the mix moves'; clean close
